ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Nonprofit Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of nonprofit fraud in Minnesota, including the $6.5 million case, and explore ways to increase oversight and accountability in the sector.
questions: How widespread is nonprofit fraud in Minnesota?
What steps can be taken to increase oversight and accountability in the sector?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale problem and spark meaningful change. By following the money and exploring ways to increase oversight and accountability, we can help prevent future cases of nonprofit fraud.
